title: Volatility in Prediction Markets: A Structural Approach
abstract: arXiv:2607.08199v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Forward-looking volatility forecasts are central inputs to derivatives pricing, market making, risk management, and volatility-linked trading strategies, with ARCH and GARCH models serving as the canonical workhorses. Such models are natural in standard asset markets, where prices are positive-valued stochastic processes and volatility is typically inferred from return dynamics. Prediction markets have a different structure: prices are bounded probabilities, payoffs are binary, and contracts resolve at known deadlines.   We develop and estimate a volatility model tailored to binary prediction markets. The model combines two economic mechanisms: a Wright-Fisher deadline-resolution component, capturing how remaining binary uncertainty is forced to resolve over time, and a Glosten-Milgrom order-flow component, capturing volatility from informed trading as reflected in spreads and volume. translated_title: 预测市场中的波动率：一种结构化方法
translated_abstract: 前瞻性波动率预测是衍生品定价、做市、风险管理以及波动率挂钩交易策略的核心输入，ARCH和GARCH模型是其中的经典主力工具。这类模型在标准资产市场中是自然的选择，因为价格是取正值的随机过程，波动率通常可以从收益动态中推断出来。而预测市场具有不同的结构：价格是有界的概率，收益是二元的，且合约在已知的截止日期结算。我们开发并估计了一个专为二元预测市场设计的波动率模型。该模型结合了两种经济机制：一个是Wright-Fisher截止日结算组件，刻画剩余的二元不确定性如何随时间推移被迫收敛解决；另一个是Glosten-Milgrom订单流组件，刻画由知情交易产生的、反映在价差和交易量中的波动率。利用Kalshi合约的大型面板数据，我们展示了……
tldr: 该论文针对二元预测市场开发了首个结构化波动率模型，将Wright-Fisher截止日结算机制与Glosten-Milgrom知情交易订单流机制相结合，并利用Kalshi合约面板数据进行估计，弥补了传统ARCH/GARCH模型无法适用于有界概率价格结构的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper develops and estimates the first structural volatility model tailored to binary prediction markets, combining a Wright-Fisher deadline-resolution mechanism with a Glosten-Milgrom informed order-flow mechanism, estimated on a large panel of Kalshi contracts to address the inadequacy of standard ARCH/GARCH models for bounded-probability price structures.
